title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 30
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 30: the day of wailing over Egypt, the cities struck by judgment, and the broken arms of Pharaoh.

questions.text: What kind of day does the chapter say Yahweh's day will be?
questions.explanation: It says the day is near, even Yahweh's day is near, and it will be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.

questions.text: Which peoples are named as falling with Egypt by the sword?
questions.explanation: The chapter names Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land allied with them as falling with them by the sword.

questions.text: How would the messengers go out to make the careless Ethiopians afraid?
questions.explanation: It says that in that day messengers will go out from before him in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid.

questions.text: By whose hand would the multitude of Egypt be made to cease?
questions.explanation: He says he will make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

answers.text: By the hand of the Ethiopians
By the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
By the hand of his people Israel
By the hand of the children of the east

questions.text: What would happen to Egypt's rivers?
questions.explanation: He says he will make the rivers dry, sell the land into the hand of evil men, and make the land desolate by the hand of strangers.

answers.text: They would be filled with ships
They would be turned to blood

questions.text: From which city would the images be made to cease?
questions.explanation: He says he will destroy the idols and cause the images to cease from Memphis, and that there will be no more a prince from the land of Egypt.

questions.text: Which place does the chapter call the stronghold of Egypt?
questions.explanation: It says he will pour his wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, and will cut off the multitude of No.

questions.text: The young men of which two cities would fall by the sword?
questions.explanation: The chapter says the young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword, and that they will go into captivity.

questions.text: What does the chapter say had been done to the arm of Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: It says: I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; behold, it has not been bound up or bandaged so that it could hold the sword.

answers.text: It had been bound with iron
It had been strengthened for war
It had been broken and not bound up
It had been washed with medicines

questions.text: What does the Lord Yahweh say he would put into the hand of the king of Babylon?
questions.explanation: He says he will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put his sword in his hand, but will break the arms of Pharaoh.
